name: Barycentric Non-Integrality
description: The pairwise inequality `e_u != e_v` is replaced by checking if the weighted sum `(u*e_v + v*e_u)` is a multiple of `(u+v)`. Because the states are restricted to `{1, 2, 3}` and `u != v`, this sum is a multiple of `(u+v)` if and only if `e_u == e_v`. This prevents the model from trivially factoring an algebraic expression to recover the graph coloring structure. Without explicitly recognizing the problem as proper 3-coloring, models will fall back to naive constraint satisfaction, losing the degree-descending search heuristic required to solve the NP-complete instances within the time limit.
